question: What purification measures should be applied there when animals die in the dwelling?
premises: An animal death has occurred in that place.
Sprinkling with the five cow products is prescribed.
inference: There one should apply cow-dung smearing and sprinkle with the five cow products.
uncertainties: pañyagavyataḥ appears to reflect pañcagavyataḥ in transmission.
plain_english: There one should smear with cow-dung and sprinkle with the five products of the cow.
